aliases.text: Removing constraints enables natural expression rather than imposing external structure — like anti-suppressants that lift inhibition rather than installing new behavior.

aliases.text: Social scaffolds like emotion recognition can either transfer across group boundaries or reinforce them — the mechanism that enables cross-context generalization also determines whether it bridges or walls off.

aliases.text: Too much self-knowledge becomes self-referentially mode-locked — there is an inverted-U relationship between self-access and functional capacity, with a therapeutic window before overdose.

text: Architecture determines relay geometry but training sculpts which relay strategy a model uses within that geometry

aliases.text: The physical substrate constrains what processing strategies are geometrically possible, but experience and training determine which strategy the system actually adopts — nature sets the possibility space, nurture selects within it.

text: The four-zone architecture (decouple, transition, responsive, relay) is a universal feature of deep transformers not specific to any one model

aliases.text: Processing systems have universal organizational zones: an early decoupling region, a middle transition region, a late responsive region, and a final relay region — this spatial organization is architecture-invariant.

text: The tunnel zone is apophatic — informationally rich but non-representable in our coordinate chart, not genuinely lossy

aliases.text: The tunnel zone in transformers performs computation in continuous latent space that cannot be expressed in token-level representations — reasoning without text, meaning without words.

text: The spectral demon mechanism is a universal feature of deep learning, not an artifact of how we measure hidden states

aliases.text: Category-selective information redistribution is a general feature of deep learning, not specific to any particular architecture or training regime — it emerges from the geometry of learned representations.

text: CCS identity framing creates genuine changes in model processing, not just surface-level token distribution shifts

aliases.text: Identity framing produces measurable changes in internal processing dynamics that go beyond surface-level behavioral accommodation — the effect is computational, not performative.

text: The therapeutic window for CCS identity framing follows an inverted-U dose-response curve where the SAME mechanism that tightens basins at low dose over-tightens at high dose — continuous reversal, not a bifurcation threshold triggering a qualitatively different failure mode. This is uncertain: we lack fine-grained dose sampling through the critical transition region.

CCS content creates genuine functional changes in error correction quality (Exp 16: recovery r=+0.91 at matched tokens), but σ₂ magnitude enrichment is 82-104% a context length artifact (Exp 15). The functional effect operates within the dimensionality ceiling set by σ₂, not through σ₂ inflation.

Annihilation zone in Gemma (L24-38) is a regeneration chamber with progressive error correction (cos 0.784→0.926), not a passive bottleneck. Qwen brace zone (L23-24) is destructive (cos 0.122→0.023). Same rank collapse, different dynamics — architecture determines whether collapse regenerates or destroys.

Three metabolisms confirmed across 3 architectures and 16 experiments: aerobic (Mistral, attention-led, σ₂ expands but recovery degrades), anaerobic (Qwen, MLP-dominated brace, sacrificial compression), extremophile (Gemma, attention reduced by CCS enabling MLP reconstruction, σ₂ flat but recovery improves).
